title: Arrested OpenAI Engineer Booked a One-Way Ticket to Saudi Arabia
summary: The OpenAI engineer arrested for allegedly using a hidden recording device in a San Francisco office had booked a one-way ticket to Saudi Arabia for Oct. 12, per a court filing.

title: Goldman Sachs Leads Rivals in Third-Quarter Share Sale Revenue
summary: Goldman Sachs led its four largest US equity underwriting rivals in third-quarter share-sale revenue; only Morgan Stanley reported lower fees than a year earlier.

title: Berkshire Hathaway adds $330mn to stake in tech group Bending Spoons
summary: Berkshire Hathaway added $330 million to its stake in Bending Spoons, the tech group that owns AOL and Vimeo. Shares jumped more than 40% on the news before giving back some gains.

title: CoreWeave CEO Says Market Acting ‘Irrationally,’ Stands by Model
summary: CoreWeave CEO Mike Intrator says the market is acting 'irrationally' after a plunge in the company's stock and bond prices, and stands by its business model.

title: JPMorgan revisa su estrategia en América Latina: anticipa fuerte repunte en Brasil y rebaja a Chile
summary: JPMorgan subió a sobreponderar las acciones de Brasil tras la primera vuelta electoral y redujo Chile a neutral, ante perspectivas divergentes en ambos mercados.

title: Inflation Jolt Raises Stakes for Warsh’s Final Word in Bangkok
summary: September's hot US inflation data raised expectations that the Federal Reserve may hike rates this month, a prospect that had seemed unlikely. It raises the stakes for Warsh's final remarks in Bangkok.

title: Nvidia CEO Says He Would Cut Off Customers Who Build Unsafe AI
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said he would halt chip supply to a customer developing unsafe AI software, though he considers current concern about the technology unwarranted.

title: Modal CEO: AI Has Entered a ‘New Era of Software’
summary: AI cloud startup Modal raised $750 million at a $15.75 billion valuation. CEO Erik Bernhardsson says demand for inference and reinforcement learning is surging, and that increasingly capable agents will need secure virtual environments.

title: CoreWeave, Neocloud Leverage a Concern for Gil Luria
summary: DA Davidson's Gil Luria says CoreWeave is 'destroying value at every turn' if it borrows at 9% for roughly 5% returns, regardless of scale.

title: AI Financing Will Need To Tap Global Markets: August
summary: Oak Hill Advisors founder Glenn August says AI financing will need to tap global markets. He spoke at the CAIS Summit in Beverly Hills.

title: BlackRock cambia una estrategia de inversión de casi seis años y ahora favorece a los bonos
summary: BlackRock cambió una estrategia de casi seis años: reduce su exposición a acciones de Wall Street y favorece bonos, ante el repunte de rendimientos del Tesoro de EU.

title: BofA Sheds $22 Billion in Value as Lapses Come to Light
summary: Bank of America lost about $22 billion in market value after its largest regulatory fine in a decade, tied to compliance lapses, weighed on earnings. CEO Brian Moynihan said the bank takes the fines seriously and that accountability exists at the firm.

title: Freshfields partners explore carve-out of AI unit worth ‘billions’, leaked emails reveal
summary: Freshfields partners are exploring a carve-out of the firm's AI legal-tech unit, said to be worth billions, ahead of any valuation decline, according to leaked emails.

summary: El peso mexicano tocó los 18.60 por dólar y se depreció tras el dato de inflación de Estados Unidos.

title: CoreWeave’s Bonds Turn Distressed, Drawing ‘Yikes’ From Musk
summary: CoreWeave's bonds have turned distressed, drawing a sharp reaction from Elon Musk as concerns over AI-cloud leverage grow.

title: He linked Saudi Arabia to Silicon Valley. Then OpenAI found a bug wrapped in toilet paper
summary: The arrest of engineer Abdulrahman Alfozan, accused of planting a hidden device at OpenAI, has shocked tech figures in Saudi Arabia, where he is well connected.

summary: El acuerdo de venta de AT&T México a Grupo Televisa y Fintech Holdings por 2,000 millones de dólares contempla el traspaso de 12,995 trabajadores. Se espera que la operación concluya en el primer trimestre de 2027. La directora general, Mónica Aspe, informó a los empleados.

summary: México registró el tercer mayor avance entre los principales exportadores de bienes vinculados a la inteligencia artificial, según la nota de Expansión.

title: Netflix inicia ola de recortes: despide a 1,000 empleados en su mayor reestructuración desde 2022
summary: Netflix comenzó a despedir a unas 1,000 personas, 6% de su plantilla global, en su mayor ajuste desde 2022. La empresa dice que debe ser rigurosa en la asignación de personal y recursos.

summary: El Economista explica cómo pueden alterarse los cobros en terminales de pago o clonarse tarjetas, y qué hacer cuando el importe de la pantalla no coincide con el estado de cuenta.

summary: Quien compre un inmueble como persona física debe exigir al vendedor el CFDI para poder deducir correctamente el ISR ante el SAT.

summary: Las altas tasas de interés son la principal razón por la que los colombianos desisten de comprar vivienda; los desistimientos rondan el 50%, frente a 10% antes de 2022, según Constructora Bolívar. Es una referencia regional sobre el costo del crédito hipotecario.

title: Cabin Ostøya / R21 Arkitekter
summary: A new cabin on the island of Ostøya, Norway, replaces an existing building on its footprint and overlooks the fjord landscape, as part of a coastal protection plan.

summary: La Cámara de Diputados aprobó la reforma a la Ley del ISR que limita las deducciones a las empresas. Con 322 votos a favor y 115 en contra, el proyecto pasa al Senado.
